item.title: Packages
item.description:
Install native .deb, .rpm, or portable .tar.gz packages into /opt/openflowlm and configure the amdxdna kernel driver and XRT runtime on x86_64 Linux.

lightbulb

Running containers or Nix? Follow the Docker or Nix & NixOS guides. Check supported Ryzen AI processors in Hardware & Quickstart .

System Requirements link

Component Requirement Status
Ryzen AI 300 / 400 / Max 300 / Z2 Extreme AMD XDNA2 NPU (/dev/accel/accel*) Supported
Ryzen 7040 / 8040 / 200-series Phoenix, Hawk Point (XDNA1) Unsupported
NPU firmware 1.1.0.0 or newer Required
Kernel driver Linux 6.17+ in-tree amdxdna, or amdxdna-dkms Required
Userspace runtime AMD XRT + libxrt_driver_xdna.so.2 (or bundled .tar.gz) Required
Locked memory ulimit -l unlimited for NPU memory buffers Required
Python Python 3.8+ (used by oflm add) Required

item.title: Docker
item.description:
Run oflm serve inside an x86_64 Linux container with /dev/accel/accel0 NPU passthrough, persistent ./oflm-data and ./npu-cache volumes, and HTTP API access on 127.0.0.1:52625.

Host Prerequisites link

Install the host amdxdna kernel driver and NPU firmware (1.1.0.0+) first so /dev/accel/accel0 exists on the Linux host (see Packages or Nix & NixOS ).

  • Official runtime image (openflowlm:runtime): Bundles userspace libxrt2 and libxrt-npu2 inside the Ubuntu 26.04 container, so host userspace XRT libraries are not required.
  • Custom minimal containers: If you build a custom image without in-container XRT packages, bind-mount host XRT (-v /opt/xilinx/xrt:/opt/xilinx/xrt:ro) and set LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib.
  • Memory locking: Always grant --cap-add=IPC_LOCK and --ulimit memlock=-1:-1 so XRT can pin NPU memory buffers.

item.title: Nix & NixOS
item.description:
Install and run OpenFlowLM (x86_64-linux) via the .#oflm Nix flake, Home Manager, or the declarative programs.openflowlm NixOS module, with user models and settings stored in ~/.config/oflm/.

Quick Start link

Run Directly via Flake link

nix run \
 github:Atomic-Germ/OpenFlowLM-Next#oflm \
 -- --help

# Or from a local checkout:
nix run .#oflm -- list

Minimal NixOS Configuration link

{
 programs.openflowlm = {
 enable = true;
 enableNPU = true;
 };
}

Declarative NixOS Module link

Import openflowlm.nixosModules.default in your system flake.nix to configure both the AMD NPU hardware stack and OpenFlowLM in one step:
